Se fiscere and his gefēra standað on ðǣm strande. Se gefēra cwið: “Saga mē, hwæt ðū hæbbe.” Se fiscere sægð, ðæt hē męte hæbbe. Hē hǣtt his gefēran ðone fisc beran. Se gefēra birð ðone fisc. Se fiscere cwið: “Ic gesēo ðē ðone fisc beran. Nū wāt ic, ðæt ðū mē hilpst.”
